subtopic: WAI-ARIA Roles, Keyboard Navigation and Focus Trapping
question_text: [CSS Architecture, Responsive Layouts & Accessibility (a11y) - Q09] When rendering an accessible modal dialog, why is keyboard 'Focus Trapping' mandatory under WCAG 2.1 Level AA?

options.text: To prevent the mouse cursor from leaving the browser viewport
To ensure keyboard-only and screen reader users pressing Tab/Shift-Tab cannot navigate into obscured background elements behind the active modal
To disable all keyboard shortcuts on the webpage
To automatically submit forms when Enter is pressed

answer_explanation: Without focus trapping, pressing Tab allows focus to escape behind the backdrop into unreachable or obscured elements, stranding assistive technology users.
reference_solution: Correct Choice: B. Rationale: Without focus trapping, pressing Tab allows focus to escape behind the backdrop into unreachable or obscured elements, stranding assistive technology users.

criteria.name: Correctness
criteria.description: Selects the exact correct technical option.
